execution_fix: Variant directory names now use a digest of the full disabled set. The frozen naming scheme truncated the sanitized subset key at 110 characters, so distinct subsets of three or more operations shared a directory and a cached probe could read another subset's tree. The fix is applied identically to all four modes; frozen pilot artifacts are left untouched.
